name: Aniyome
source:
Main character lost his parents in an accident and was brought up by brother as a result. Now protagonist has inferiority complex over his brother. Brother marries kind and gentle girl Miwa. Jealousy burns up to the point when protagonist desires to rob his brother off the happiness in life starting with his beautiful wife.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的双亲在一场事故中去世，他也因此由哥哥抚养长大。如今，主人公对哥哥怀有深深的自卑感。哥哥娶了一名善良温柔的女孩——神乐美和。嫉妒在主人公心中愈演愈烈，令他萌生了夺走哥哥人生中所有幸福的欲望——而首先要抢走的，便是哥哥美丽的妻子。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
